crossRefs.note: After her, he took Maacah the daughter of Absalom; and she bore him Abijah, Attai, Ziza, and Shelomith.
He reigned three years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Maacah the daughter of Abishalom.
Zelah, Eleph, the Jebusite (also called Jerusalem), Gibeath, and Kiriath; fourteen cities with their villages. This is…
So they passed on and went their way; and the sun went down on them near Gibeah, which belongs to Benjamin.
Behold, an old man came from his work out of the field at evening. Now the man was from the hill country of Ephraim…
Saul also went to his house to Gibeah; and the army went with him, whose hearts God had touched.
Now there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of his life.

translations.web: He reigned three years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Micaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. There was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.
translations.bsb: and he reigned in Jerusalem three years. His mother’s name was Micaiah daughter of Uriel; she was from Gibeah. And there was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.
translations.kjv: He reigned three years in Jerusalem. His mother's name also was Michaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. And there was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.
translations.asv: Three years reigned he in Jerusalem: and his mother's name was Micaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. And there was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.
